claim_text: Real partial UT enriches CAI-relevant state
metric: domain-balanced CAI AUEBC; lower is better
domains_improved: 3/6 versus shuffled; 3/6 versus static; 1/6 versus positions; 1/6 versus reconstruction
CI_or_bootstrap: shuffled-real bootstrap CI [-0.0026525085976680752,+0.011155969668411293]; static-real CI [+0.004075379942611691,+0.02063618423120308]; positions/reconstruction CIs entirely below zero
notes: Real content beats static but does not robustly beat shuffled and is substantially worse than positions-only and reconstruction controls.

claim_text: Dynamic state improves valuation over static M1
domains_improved: 4/6 versus static; 5/6 versus positions; 2/6 versus shuffled
notes: Dynamic real does not significantly beat static and is significantly worse than shuffled in the primary regret contrast.

claim_text: Feedback changes and improves acquisition decisions
metric: closed-loop CAI AUEBC; lower is better
notes: Feedback is measurably worse in aggregate; P16 must diagnose whether harmful rank turnover explains the result.

claim_text: Final closed-loop performance remains weak and heterogeneous
metric: frozen CAI AUEBC; lower is better
notes: This is strong evidence for a negative and heterogeneous boundary, not evidence that the MAVIS system improves performance.
